result.emotionalMirror: Anxiety in love often means you care deeply. But care and fear can become hard to separate. What you are feeling right now is real — and it is worth looking at without immediately trying to fix it.

result.closingLine: Something in you already knows what you are reaching toward.

result.closingLine: 你内心深处，已经知道自己在朝什么靠近。

result.emotionalMirror: Sadness in love is not a mistake. It often means something genuinely mattered to you. That matters. Letting yourself feel this is not weakness — it is honest.

result.closingLine: Something in you already knows what you are reaching toward.

result.closingLine: Something in you already knows what you are reaching toward.

result.closingLine: Something in you already knows what you are reaching toward.
